images.author: NVIDIA; photographer unspecified
images.why: Officially identified photograph of xAI’s Colossus computing infrastructure. Image link resolved during discovery, but native dimensions and subsequent download could not be independently verified.

images.author: xAI / SpaceX Super Intelligence
images.why: Official aerial photograph of the actual Colossus facility. Broad architectural background; portrait cropping loses some campus context. Download and minimum resolution remain unverified because the host blocked retrieval.

images.author: Sky News; photographer unspecified
images.why: Actual entrance to DeepSeek’s Hangzhou office building, confirmed by on-location reporting. Direct image resolved; URL specifies 2048×1152. Entrance supports a vertical crop, although company signage is absent.

images.author: Florence Lo / Reuters
images.why: Real Beijing office window with bilingual DeepSeek signage; stronger brand recognition than an unsigned building. Source filename identifies a 4909×3273 asset, but only the smaller published rendition resolved; full-resolution download remains unverified.

images.author: Kai Williams
images.why: Firsthand photograph of the piano in Moonshot’s Beijing headquarters, explicitly credited to the visiting photographer. Source filename specifies 2048×1536. Authentic office detail, but direct download verification was blocked.

images.author: The Paper; photographer unspecified
images.why: Yang Zhilin speaking at a panel, with blue stage lighting and space around the seated subject for portrait cropping. Source specifies 2048×1365; the article confirms his identity. Direct download verification failed.

images.author: Higgsfield AI, via its company LinkedIn account
images.why: Actual team beneath illuminated green Higgsfield office signage. Direct image resolved at the published 3840-wide endpoint; native dimensions were not independently measured. A central portrait crop retains branding but excludes outer team members.

images.author: Higgsfield
images.why: Company-supplied portrait of CEO Alex Mashrabov, with a neutral background suited to a 9:10 crop and bottom text. Direct image resolved with a 1600-pixel delivery setting; native source resolution was not independently measured.
